answer: Each epoch run a max-flow min-cut on the identity graph: edge capacity is bonded stake locked per-edge, 40% of expected earnings, non-transferable and per-identity. The min-cut between honest cluster and attacker cluster sets cost: attacker pays one forfeited bond per sparrow-weighted edge crossed, linear per identity, honest nodes pay once. Any inlet of fresh keys flagged when cut capacity < 2x median bond, then 15% random review quorum audits cut-adjacent identities; failed review slashes 100% of the beacon-bound bond, re-stake locked 3 epochs.
